newsitem.title: ISRAEL: El Al expects $40 million loss in 1997 - paper.
newsitem.headline: El Al expects $40 million loss in 1997 - paper.

text.p: El Al Israel Airlines expects to lose $40 million in 1997, the daily newspaper Haaretz on Friday quoted company Director-General Yoel Feldshuh as telling the board of directors.
The newspaper quoted him as saying the losses were figured into the budget. Losses in 1996 reached $80 million, Haaretz said.
El Al officials were not immediately available to comment.
The government controls 100 percent of El Al. It wants to privatise the national airline but a ban on flying on the Jewish Sabbath, and high security costs, have deterred investors.
The newspaper quoted the director-general as saying El Al could absorb the losses and balance its budget in two years.
